cfg.geen: Jensiechat has not been set up yet: there is no config.php. Copy config.voorbeeld.php to config.php in this folder (or to jensiechat-config.php, one folder above your web folder) and fill it in.
cfg.tikfout: There is a typo in {bestand} around line {regel}. Check the quotes and commas there. ({fout})
cfg.geen_lijst: {bestand} does not return any settings. The file must start with <?php and contain the line return [, as in config.voorbeeld.php.
cfg.adres_leeg: In config.php, fill in the web address of this folder at adres, for example https://yourpractice.com/chat
cfg.adres_https: The adres in config.php must start with https://. Meta only works with a secure connection.
cfg.wachtwoord_leeg: Fill in a dashboard_wachtwoord (dashboard password) in config.php, at least 12 characters.
cfg.wachtwoord_kort: The dashboard_wachtwoord in config.php is too short. Choose one of at least 12 characters.
stop.uitleg: Change it in the file manager of your host and reload this page.
stop.link: This link is not working right now.
stop.niet_ingesteld: Jensiechat has not been set up.
stop.onverwacht: Something went wrong. Check the log under Health, or the error log of your host.
fout.sqlite: The PHP extension pdo_sqlite is switched off. Switch it on in your host's control panel (PHP settings, extensions).
fout.opslag: Jensiechat cannot store data anywhere. Create a folder jensiechat-data next to your web folder (or set datamap in config.php) and give the server write access.
fout.curl: The PHP extension curl is switched off
fout.ig_niet_gevonden: Instagram account not found with this token
meta.venster: Meta does not allow this message: the comment is older than 7 days or already received a private reply.
meta.niet_beschikbaar: This person cannot receive messages right now (a setting of that account).
meta.token: The token does not work (any more). Create a new token at Meta and put it in config.php.
meta.recht: The app is missing a permission from Meta, or the switch for message access is off.
meta.limiet: Meta limit reached, Jensiechat pauses for a moment.
reden.testmodus: Test mode: this account is not on the test list
reden.te_oud: Older than 7 days: Meta no longer allows a private reply
reden.al_gehad: Already received this message in the last {uur} hours
reden.onderbroken: Interrupted while sending; check in Instagram whether the message arrived
log.ig_niet_gevonden: Instagram account not found with this token: {fout}
log.volgende_gebonden: Automation '{naam}' now belongs to the new post "{post}"
log.knop_geweigerd: Meta refused the message with buttons, it is sent as text: {fout}
log.limiet: Meta reports a limit, three minutes pause. Messages wait and then continue by themselves: {fout}
log.controle_kwartier: The check for new comments has been failing for fifteen minutes. {fout}
log.vastleggen_mislukt: Saving a comment failed, it will come back: {fout}
log.webhook_aan: Notifications for comments switched on for the account
log.gewist: Data of one person erased on request ({n} comment(s))
log.webhook_gecontroleerd: Meta has verified the webhook address
log.handtekening: Webhook notification with a wrong signature refused (is the app secret in config.php correct?)
api.te_vaak: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in fifteen minutes.
api.ig_onbekend: Instagram account unknown. Has the token been filled in?
val.knop_lang: A button fits {max} characters. This has {n}.
val.knop2_tekst: Give the second button a text, or remove the second link.
val.knop2_link: The second button needs a link.
val.knop_geen_link_in_tekst: With buttons the link sits behind the button. Remove {link} and {link2} from the text.
val.knop_bericht_lang: Above buttons, {max} characters fit. This has {n}. Shorten the text or choose the text style.
val.trefwoord: Fill in at least one keyword.
val.slug: Only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (2 to 40 characters).
val.link_nodig: The message uses {link}, fill in the link.
val.link2_nodig: The message uses {link2}, fill in the second link.
val.te_lang: The message is too long for Instagram: {n} of 1000 bytes.
h.voet_gemaakt: Made with Jensiechat by Jens Kemna,
h.voet_geen: Not a product of ManyChat or Meta.
h.slot_uitleg: Enter the dashboard password. It is the dashboard_wachtwoord in your config.php.
h.au_uitleg: A keyword in a comment, a message back. Switch on as many as you like.
h.probeer_uitleg: Type what someone might write under a post. You see which automation responds and what the message will be. Nothing is sent.
h.me_uitleg: Everyone who commented with a keyword, with labels. Jensiechat adds some labels itself; add your own with the plus.
h.ac_uitleg: Every comment with a keyword: who, under which post, and what happened.
h.ge_uitleg: Is everything working? Here you see the token, the own check, the notifications from Meta and where your data is stored.
h.wissen_uitleg: Does someone ask you to delete their data? Fill in the Instagram name. Name, ID, comment, labels and log lines with that name are removed; the numbers stay. After 90 days this happens automatically.
h.trefwoorden_uitleg: Capitals do not matter, and "guide!" counts too. It has to be a separate word: "guides" does not count.
h.welke_post_uitleg: Choose "the next one" if you still have to publish the post: the automation then attaches itself to your next post.
h.hoe_link: How does someone get the link?
h.als_knop_uitleg: The link sits behind a button under the message. If Meta refuses the button, the link goes below the text.
h.in_tekst_uitleg: The link appears as an address in the message. Put {link} where it should go.
h.link_uitleg: Where the button or {link} goes. Clicks are counted through the short link.
h.publiek_uitleg: Jensiechat picks one each time, never the same one twice in a row. Leave empty if you do not want to reply publicly.
h.aan_uitleg: Responds to new comments from the moment you switch it on.
h.testmodus_uitleg: Only the accounts below get a message. Everyone else is skipped.
js.lukte_niet_verbinding: That did not work: no connection.
chk.token_leeg: No token filled in yet. Create the token at Meta (system user in Business settings) and put it at meta_token in config.php.
chk.token_nog_niet: Not checked yet. This happens in the first round of the cron job, or right now with the button next to this.
chk.token_stap: Next step: create a new token for the system user at Meta (Business settings, System users, Generate token) with the permissions instagram_basic, instagram_manage_comments and instagram_manage_messages, and put it at meta_token in config.php. Then press Check now.
chk.account_niet: Not found yet. This happens by itself once the token works.
chk.account_stap: The token works, but sees no Instagram account. Next step: give the system user access to your Instagram account in Business settings, then create a new token and put it in config.php.
chk.webhook_geen_geheim: The app secret is missing in config.php, so notifications are refused. The own check picks everything up, within half a minute.
chk.webhook_normaal: That is normal: without review by Meta, notifications only come for accounts with a role on the app. The own check picks up all comments.
chk.controle_rust: The cron job runs (last {tijd}). No automation is switched on yet, so comments are not checked yet.
chk.cron_elke_minuut: The cron job runs every minute.
chk.cron_weg: The cron job last ran {tijd}. Check in your host's control panel whether the scheduled task still exists. The command:
chk.cron_nooit: The cron job has not run yet. In your host's control panel, create a scheduled task (cron job) that runs every minute, with this command. If php has a different path at your host, use that path.
chk.leespauze_p: Meta reported a limit on reading. The check waits until {klok}. Messages in the queue still go out.
chk.verbruik_hoog: Above 60% the check only looks once a minute.
chk.knoppen_nee: Meta refused a message with buttons. Jensiechat sends the same content as text with the link below, and tries buttons again later.
chk.aanroepen_p: {n} in the last hour. Jensiechat slows down by itself based on the usage Meta reports. Above {budget} per hour the own check stops as an emergency brake and only sending continues.
chk.pauze_p: Meta reported a limit. Jensiechat waits until {klok} and then continues by itself.
chk.wachtrij_1: 1 message is waiting to be sent.
chk.wachtrij_n: {n} messages are waiting to be sent.
chk.fouten_p: {n} in the last 24 hours. See the log.
chk.fouten_geen: No errors in the last 24 hours.
chk.data_open: The database can be downloaded over the internet. Your server does not read the .htaccess file. Move the data folder outside your web folder (datamap in config.php) or ask your host for help. Do not switch anything on until this is fixed.
chk.data_webmap: The database is inside your web folder, protected with .htaccess. Safer is a folder jensiechat-data next to your web folder. If that is not possible, set a path outside the web folder at datamap in config.php.
chk.data_ok: The database is outside your web folder and cannot be downloaded over the internet.
chk.config_in_map: Your config.php is in the Jensiechat folder and is protected; one folder above your web folder (as jensiechat-config.php) is safer still.
ov.leeg: No comments with a keyword yet.
ov.leeg_aan_1: 1 automation is switched on. As soon as someone comments, you will see it here.
ov.leeg_aan_n: {n} automations are switched on. As soon as someone comments, you will see it here.
ov.leeg_uit: Switch on an automation under Automations, and Jensiechat starts listening.
ov.week_sub: {verstuurd} messages sent in the last seven days. Since the start: {totaal} comments, link taps: {geklikt}.
ov.geen_posts: As soon as comments come in, you see per post how many people got the message and clicked through.
ov.grafiek_label: Comments, messages and clicks per day, last 30 days
ov.grafiek_tip: Point at a day for the numbers.
au.leeg: No automations yet. Create one with the button above: a keyword, a message and a link.
au.aangezet: Switched on. It responds to new comments from now on.
me.leeg: Nobody yet. As soon as someone comments with a keyword, they appear here, with the labels that go with it.
me.meer: And {n} more people. Search or filter to see them.
ac.leeg: No comments with a keyword yet. Try it yourself: put the automation in test mode and comment with the keyword under a post from your second account.
ac.t_wachtrij: It is in the queue and goes out as soon as possible.
ac.t_nog_niet: Still not sent: see the error.
ac.t_antwoord_niet: The reply failed again: see the error.
ge.webhook_staat_aan: Notifications are switched on at Meta.
ge.wis_zeker: Erase all data of {naam}? This cannot be undone.
ge.niets_gevonden: No data found under this name.
bl.media_volgende: The next post or reel I publish
bl.std_bericht: Hi! Thanks for your comment. Tap the button and it is yours.
bl.std_antwoord_1: Sent! Have a look in your messages.
bl.std_antwoord_3: On its way, check your messages.
bl.bewaren_mislukt: Saving did not work: no connection.
bl.weg_zeker: Delete this automation? Links in messages already sent keep working and the numbers are kept.
bl.weg_mislukt: Deleting did not work: no connection.
